quickFacts.label: Dinner Only
quickFacts.value: $35++ per person on Thursday at 5:30 PM

pages.title: Palmetto Cup
body: The Palmetto Cup is BL9's Member-Member event for April 15 and 16, 2026.
This year's theme is Fiesta Fairway. Members are invited to dress in their favorite fiesta colors, optional, and enjoy two days of golf, food, cocktails, dinner, music, and fun.

pages.title: Event Format
body: Mulligans sold both days for $5 via member charge

pages.title: Food, Drinks & Festivities
body: Day 1, Oaks Dining Room: Heavy appetizers and cocktails after golf
Day 2, Oaks Dining Room at 5:30 PM: Appetizers, buffet dinner, dessert, music and fun
Prize for most creative outfits, awarded with golf prizes
Dinner-only registration available for members unable to golf

pages.title: Registration
body: Sign up begins on ForeTees Wednesday, 3/18/26 at 7:00 AM
Sign up ends Sunday, 4/5/26 at 5:00 PM
Sign up with a partner, or the Pro Shop can help find one
Dinner only registration is available on ForeTees for $35++ per person

pages.title: Eligibility & Notices
body: All BL9 members are encouraged to play
To be eligible to place or win in the Palmetto Cup, both partners must have played in at least two, or 20%, of BL9's 2026 events
Both partners must also have an established handicap leading up to the event

pages.title: Cancellation Policy
body: Cancellations less than 72 hours prior to the event result in a charge of $35 or $55 per person for food, and $10 for golf.

pages.title: Questions
body: Additional details, pairings, and event-day instructions can be added later as they become available.
